list.name: service
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT service FROM events WHERE type = 'scenario.completed' ORDER BY service;

targets.rawSql: SELECT (percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int) / 1000.0)::numeric(10,2) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT (percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int) / 1000.0)::numeric(10,2) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT (percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int) / 1000.0)::numeric(10,2) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT (max((payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int) / 1000.0)::numeric(10,2) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(received_at, $__interval) AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int) AS p95, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int) AS p99 FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT 'step_0_to_2 (LLM parse + TravelPayouts + AMA merge)' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'step_0_to_2_full_aviasales_call')::int)::int AS ms FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) UNION ALL SELECT 'step_3 (recommendation engine)' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'step_3_recommendation_engine')::int)::int AS ms FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT received_at AS "Время", service AS "Service", data AS "Запрос", ((payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int / 1000.0)::numeric(10,1) AS "Total sec", (payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'step_0_to_2_full_aviasales_call')::int AS "Step0-2 ms", (payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'step_3_recommendation_engine')::int AS "Step3 ms" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int DESC LIMIT 50;
